<thought>I'll retrieve polymorphs for a small set of oxide compositions using the batch_retrieve_polymorphs tool with the required filters (max_energy_above_hull = 0.3, max_per_composition = 3). This will create JSON files in the specified directory, after which I can list the files to confirm and later consolidate them.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
<action_input>{
    "compositions": ["TiO2", "SiO2", "Al2O3", "Fe2O3", "CuO"],
    "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
    "max_per_composition": 3,
    "save_directory": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/0_batch_retrieve_oxide_polymorphs_trial_13/oxides_data"
}
